newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S&P assigns claims-paying rating to Norway's Vesta.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns claims-paying rating to Norway's Vesta.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said it assigned its A minus claims-paying ability rating to Norway's Vesta Forsikring AS.

The rating is based on Vesta's position as a strategically core company within the Skandia group and also reflects its improving position within the Norwegian insurance market, its good operating performance and capitalisation, S&P said in a statement in Stockholm.
But it said the Norwegian insurance markets are highly competitive and the rating agency believes Vesta will have to aim for maximum operating efficiency if it is to continue to thrive long-term.
